learning_objective: 🎯 Let us find repeating magic in numbers, shapes, and the beautiful world around us!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: A pattern is a design or a list of numbers that repeats again and again by following a special magic rule!
We see patterns in butterfly wings, flower petals, and beautiful rangoli designs drawn on the floor during festivals.
Numbers can also play a repeating game! Like 2, 4, 6, 8. Can you guess the rule? We are adding 2 every time!

fun_activity.title: 🍃 Leaf and Stone Pattern
fun_activity.instructions: Collect some leaves and small stones. Arrange them in a repeating pattern on the ground, like leaf, stone, leaf, stone!

quick_recap: ⭐ Patterns repeat themselves following a hidden rule.
⭐ We can find beautiful patterns in shapes, colors, and numbers.
⭐ Finding the rule helps us guess what will come next in the line!
